subject: Predeclared gates for arms F and G, written BEFORE either was pushed
why_this_file_exists: Arms D and E on 2026-08-21 were pushed WITHOUT a predeclared gate, minutes after arm A's result. This file exists so that does not repeat. Nothing below was written after seeing a result.
shared_preconditions: All 25 games run and hold their full 7,920s slot.
Peak GPU KV cache usage strictly below 0.90.
Zero genuine vLLM relaunch-to-stock events (the phrase appears in every kernel log at t~8s as echoed setup SOURCE; check KV cache size is 398,272, not 199,136).

q38-ctxwin-up16-imgtok-v1.change: MULTIMODAL_UPSCALE 8 -> 16 AND the image-token estimator fix, both on the winning 49,152 window
q38-ctxwin-up16-imgtok-v1.hypothesis: Upscale 16 alone FAILED (23 levels vs 33) because it raises the ESTIMATED image charge 1,585 -> 3,891 against a true 256 -> 1,024, spending the raised context budget on phantom tokens. The estimator fix drops the upscale-16 charge to 1,039. This is the ONLY configuration in which the visual-resolution hypothesis gets a fair test: 2x2 grid cells per vision token at roughly unchanged retained history.
PROMOTE_requires_all_of: total_levels >= 33, i.e. at least ties the incumbent
paired sign test against the incumbent shows more games gained than lost
q38-ctxwin-up16-imgtok-v1.INCONCLUSIVE_band: total_levels 30 to 32. A tie is NOT a promotion; the incumbent ships.
q38-ctxwin-up16-imgtok-v1.note_on_confound: This arm changes TWO things at once. That is deliberate: the estimator fix is the enabler that makes upscale 16 affordable, not an independent treatment. If it wins, the follow-up must separate them.

q38-ctxwin-temp03-v1.change: LOCAL_ANALYZER_TEMPERATURE 0.6 -> 0.3 on the winning window. One env var, no source change.
q38-ctxwin-temp03-v1.hypothesis: Sampling has never been touched in this project. Direction chosen AGAINST the intuitive one: the obvious move is to raise temperature for exploration and for per-draw variance (worth +0.22 board per +0.10 sigma at N=48), but our own 500-run measurement found failing runs have HIGHER action entropy and do not cycle. Our failure mode is not too little exploration.
PROMOTE_requires_all_of: paired sign test against the incumbent shows more games gained than lost
q38-ctxwin-temp03-v1.known_risk_if_promoted: Lower temperature almost certainly LOWERS per-draw sigma, which is a real cost on a max-of-N public board through 2026-09-30. If this arm wins on levels, the promotion decision must weigh that: a capability gain of less than about +0.2 board would be cancelled by the variance it removes. Do not ship it on a marginal level win.

what_neither_gate_can_establish: A hidden-set gain. Per-draw board sigma is 0.315. These gates catch regressions and confirm mechanisms; the paired sign test against the incumbent is the deciding statistic, not the level total.
